## Summary

- Report `not_heating` when the group climbs less than 0.25 C above its coldest reading in the past 30 seconds, so a machine with the standby switch on no longer shows a countdown.
- Run this check before the rate estimate, so pressing standby mid-heat ends a countdown already in progress.
- Keep the existing recent-rate ETA. A 30 second average lags the slow start of a heat-up and put the first recorded Bengle estimate 98 s off, against 9 s today.
- Let a session that already published regain its countdown on a sustained slow rise after a stall. The cold-start gate is unchanged for sessions that never published.
- Bump the plugin to 1.0.5 so installed copies are replaced.

## Linked Issue

N/A

## Verification

- `node --test test/plugins/time_to_ready_test.cjs` covers standby from wake, standby pressed and released mid-heat, cooling on standby, and recovery from a temperature dip.
- `node --test test/plugins/time_to_ready_test.cjs` also covers a 0.03 K/s resume after standby, the same resume after cooling past the session reset, standby noise with single-reading spikes, and a slow rise that never published.
- The slow-resume fix was verified by these tests only and was not rerun on hardware.
- Tested against a real DE1 Pro (firmware 1357) using the physical standby button. The plugin from `3ba3e90f` ran in a Node process on the live `ws/v1/machine/snapshot` stream, side by side with the installed 1.0.4:
  - Standby on, group flat at about 26 C for 100 s: no countdown in 161 updates and `not_heating` at 29 s. The installed 1.0.4 published a false 300 s ETA in 41 of the 161.
  - Standby released from cold: countdown appeared after 12 s.
  - Standby pressed mid-heat at 68 C: countdown ended after 33 s and `not_heating` followed at 40 s, because residual heat kept the group rising a further 2.6 C.
  - Standby released again: a new countdown appeared after 16 s and the group reached target.

## Impact

- `timeToReady` reports `not_heating` once the group has stopped climbing for 30 seconds instead of 60, including during a countdown. Residual heat can extend this after standby is pressed mid-heat. The event shape is unchanged.
- `doc/Plugins.md` is updated.
